content.text: Games are a great way to improve your language skills.
content.trans: 游戏是提高你的语言技能的好方法。

content.text: I'm not the lead.
content.trans: 我不是主创。

content.text: The game that they're playing in this dialogue is a really fun one for numbers.
content.trans: 他们正在玩这个游戏，对于数字来说真是太有趣了。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Because the whole point of the game,
content.trans: 因为游戏的初衷是...

content.text: the whole purpose of the game is to make most,
content.trans: 游戏的真正目的就是让你赢。

content.text: the most money of anyone playing.
content.trans: 谁赚的钱最多。

content.text: And this is a really fun one because you get to buy houses and hotels.
content.trans: 这真是一个非常有趣的一件事，因为你可以买房子和酒店。

content.text: And there's simple street names and place names.
content.trans: 而且，有简单的街道名和地名。

content.text: Yeah. Yeah.
content.trans: 是的。是的。

content.text: Like Park Avenue or the Boardwalk.
content.trans: 就像帕克大道或板球场一样。

content.text: So you'll learn a lot of really great things about American culture and English.
content.trans: 所以你将学到很多关于美国文化和英语的很棒的东西。

content.text: Yeah, it's a really good game, very popular.
content.trans: 是的，这是一款非常棒的游戏，很受欢迎。

content.text: I'm sure they have it in your language, but if you could get it in English,
content.trans: 我确定他们在你的语言中有的，但如果能用英文的话，那就更好了。

content.text: that would be really great.
content.trans: 那真是太棒了。

content.text: And also another really good game to play with your friends to practice your vocab is Scrabble.
content.trans: 而且和朋友玩拼字游戏来练习你们的词汇也是非常好的一个选择。

content.text: Scrabble, that's hard. Scrabble is a game about words.
content.trans: 拼字，那可真难。拼字是一场关于词语的游戏。

content.text: And so basically you have to make words out of letters.
content.trans: 所以，基本上你得用字母造词。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: And whoever has the most interesting words, unique words, that person wins.
content.trans: 谁说得最有意思，用的最独特的好词，那个人就赢了。

content.text: So obviously it's a great game to improve your vocab
content.trans: 当然，这是一个提高词汇的好游戏。

content.text: because you also learned some words that maybe you didn't know before and your friends knew.
content.trans: 因为你也学了一些之前不知道的单词，朋友们也都认识了。

content.text: So it's really fun to play.
content.trans: 真的玩得很开心。

content.text: Obviously don't play with any native English speakers because they might win.
content.trans: 当然不要和任何母语人士开玩笑，因为他们可能会赢。

content.text: So, but it's a really cool game to play if you have any friends who are also learning English.
content.trans: 所以，如果你有学习英语的朋友，玩这个游戏真的很酷。

content.text: You can get together, play Scrabble, and it's a fun way to improve your vocab
content.trans: 你可以聚在一起玩拼字游戏，这是一个提高词汇量的有趣方式。

content.text: and to also fight a little bit because all the time some people are trying to make up new words that don't really exist.
content.trans: 而且也要稍微拼一下凑一点，因为总有一些人是想出一些根本不存在的新词来。

content.text: We call them cheaters.
content.trans: 我们称他们为作弊者。

content.text: Cheaters.
content.trans: 骗子。

content.text: So yeah, let us know about your game experiences.
content.trans: 所以，让我们知道你的游戏经历吧。

content.text: Do you like to play games?
content.trans: 你喜欢玩游戏吗？

content.text: Do you have a favorite game?
content.trans: 你有没有一喜欢的游戏？

content.text: Do you have a favorite game?
content.trans: 你喜欢的游戏是你的最爱吗？

content.text: Practice some of these and let us know how they go.
content.trans: 练习一下这些，我们来听听你的感受吧。

content.text: Alright, we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 好的，我们到时候见。

content.trans: 英语：英语Pod.com

content.text: Bye everyone.
content.trans: Bye everyone. (翻译成中文) 你好，大家。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
